l0.WHO_PAYS: Hypothesized liquidity-demanding holders forced to unwind and counterparties unable or unwilling to warehouse short-term FX inventory. The source does not establish that reported holders are forced sellers, who initiates an unwind or that their holdings are unhedged.
l0.WHY_PERSIST: Different mandates, capital/risk constraints and coarse public position disclosure could leave short-lived liquidity premia. Equally, all useful positioning information may be anticipated or already reflected in prices.
l0.CHEAP_DATA_NOW: CFTC documents freely available downloadable COT reports and the normal Tuesday position-date/Friday 15:30 Eastern release convention. l0.FATAL_PROBLEM: Look-ahead from Tuesday dating; Friday/holiday publication ambiguity; final-history revisions; classification not equivalent to sentiment or net economic risk; contemporaneous price-driven positioning; hedged or offsetting positions; USD/CAD inversion, maturity/roll basis; averaged indicative FX rates not executable closes; unresolved free rights/schema/clock.

FX proxy could reflect global USD, commodity and rate risk rather than CAD positioning; benchmark and sign conversion must be chosen before outcomes.
A functioning documentation shell is not authentication of a usable free historical rate series or its publication and revision semantics.
